ayahs.2: Yeh hai tere parwardigar ki us mehrbani ka zikr jo us ne apne bande Zakariya par ki thi.
ayahs.3: Jab ke us ne apne Rabb se chupke chupke dua ki thi.
ayahs.4: Ke aye mere parwardigar! Meri haddiyan kamzor hogayi hain aur sar budhape ki wajah se bharak utha hai, lekin main kabhi bhi tujh se dua kar ke mahroom nahi raha.
ayahs.5: Mujhe apne marne ke baad apne qaraabat walon ka dar hai, meri biwi bhi baanjh hai, pas tu mujhe apne paas se waaris ata farma.
ayahs.6: Jo mera bhi waaris ho aur Yaqoob (alaihis salaam) ke khaandaan ka bhi jaanasheen aur mere Rabb! Tu use maqbool banda bana le.
ayahs.7: Aye Zakariya! Hum tujhe ek bachche ki khushkhabri dete hain jis ka naam Yahya hai, hum ne is se pehle is ka hum-naam bhi kisi ko nahi kiya.
ayahs.8: Zakariya (alaihis salaam) kehne lage mere Rabb! Mere haan ladka kaise hoga, jab ke meri biwi baanjh aur main khud budhape ke intehaai zaaf ko pahunch chuka hoon.
ayahs.9: Irshaad hua ke wada isi tarah ho chuka, tere Rabb ne farma diya hai ke mujh par to yeh bilkul aasan hai aur tu khud jab ke kuchh na tha main tujhe paida kar chuka hoon.
ayahs.10: Kehne lage mere parwardigar mere liye koi alaamat muqarrar farma de, irshaad hua ke tere liye alaamat yeh hai ke baa-wujood bhala changa hone ke tu teen raaton tak kisi shakhs se bol na sakega.
ayahs.11: Ab Zakariya (alaihis salaam) apne hujre se nikal kar apni qaum ke paas aakar unhe ishaara karte hain ke tum subah-o-shaam Allah Taala ki tasbeeh bayan karo.
ayahs.12: Aye Yahya! Meri kitaab ko mazbooti se thaam le, aur hum ne use ladakpan hi se daanaai ata farma di.
ayahs.13: Aur apne paas se shafqat aur paakeezgi bhi, woh parhezgaar shakhs tha.
ayahs.14: Aur apne maan baap se nek sulook karne wala tha, woh sarkash aur gunahgaar na tha.
ayahs.15: Us par salaam hai jis din woh paida hua aur jis din woh mare aur jis din woh zinda kar ke uthaaya jaaye.
ayahs.16: Is kitaab mein Maryam ka bhi waaqia bayan kar, jab ke woh apne ghar ke logon se alaihda hokar mashriqi jaanib aayin.
ayahs.17: Aur un logon ki taraf se parda kar liya, phir hum ne is ke paas apni rooh (Jibraeel alaihis salaam) ko bheja, pas woh is ke saamne poora aadmi ban kar zaahir hua.
ayahs.18: Yeh kehne lagin main tujh se Rahman ki panah maangti hoon agar tu kuchh bhi Allah se darne wala hai.
ayahs.19: Us ne jawab diya ke main to Allah ka bheja hua qaasid hoon, tujhe ek paakeeza ladka dene aaya hoon.
ayahs.20: Kehne lagin bhala mere haan bachcha kaise ho sakta hai? Mujhe to kisi insan ka haath tak nahi laga aur na main badkaar hoon.
ayahs.21: Us ne kaha baat to yehi hai, lekin tere parwardigar ka irshaad hai ke woh mujh par bahut hi aasan hai, hum to use logon ke liye ek nishani bana denge aur apni khaas rahmat, yeh to ek tai-shuda baat hai.
ayahs.22: Pas woh haml se hogayin aur isi wajah se woh yaksoo hokar ek door ki jagah chali gayin.
ayahs.23: Phir dard-e-zeh use ek khajoor ke tane ke neeche le aaya, boli kaash! Main is se pehle hi mar gayi hoti aur logon ki yaad se bhi bhooli bisri ho jaati.
ayahs.24: Itne mein use neeche se hi aawaaz di ke aazurda-khaatir na ho, tere Rabb ne tere paon tale ek chashma jaari kar diya hai.
ayahs.25: Aur is khajoor ke tane ko apni taraf hila, yeh tere saamne taro-taaza pakki khajooren gira dega.
ayahs.26: Ab chain se kha pi aur aankhen thandi rakh, agar tujhe koi insan nazar pad jaaye to keh dena ke main ne Allah Rahman ke naam ka roza maan rakha hai, main aaj kisi shakhs se baat na karoongi.
ayahs.27: Ab Hazrat Eesa (alaihis salaam) ko liye hue woh apni qaum ke paas aayin. Sab kehne lage Maryam tu ne badi buri harkat ki.
ayahs.28: Aye Haaroon ki bahen! Na to tera baap bura aadmi tha aur na teri maan badkaar thi.
ayahs.29: Maryam ne apne bachche ki taraf ishaara kiya. Sab kehne lage ke lo bhala hum god ke bachche se baaten kaise karen?
ayahs.30: Bachcha bol utha ke main Allah Taala ka banda hoon, us ne mujhe kitaab ata farmaayi aur mujhe apna paighambar banaaya hai.
ayahs.31: Aur us ne mujhe ba-barkat kiya hai jahan bhi main hoon, aur us ne mujhe namaz aur zakaat ka hukm diya hai jab tak bhi main zinda rahoon.
ayahs.32: Aur us ne mujhe apni waalida ka khidmat-guzaar banaaya hai aur mujhe sarkash aur bad-bakht nahi kiya.
ayahs.33: Aur mujh par meri paidaish ke din aur meri maut ke din aur jis din ke main dobara zinda khada kiya jaoonga, salaam hi salaam hai.
ayahs.34: Yeh hai saheeh waaqia Eesa ibn-e-Maryam (alaihis salaam) ka, yehi hai woh haq baat jis mein log shak-o-shubha mein mubtala hain.
ayahs.35: Allah Taala ke liye aulaad ka hona laayeq nahi, woh to bilkul paak zaat hai, woh to jab kisi kaam ke sar-anjaam dene ka irada karta hai to use keh deta hai ke ho ja, woh usi waqt ho jaata hai.
ayahs.36: Mera aur tum sab ka parwardigar sirf Allah Taala hi hai, tum sab usi ki ibaadat karo, yehi seedhi raah hai.
ayahs.37: Phir yeh firqe aapas mein ikhtilaaf karne lage, pas kaafiron ke liye wail hai ek bade (sakht) din ki haazri se.
ayahs.38: Kya khoob dekhne sunne wale honge us din jab ke hamare saamne haazir honge, lekin aaj to yeh zaalim log sareeh gumraahi mein pade hue hain.
ayahs.39: To unhe us ranj-o-afsos ke din ka dar suna de jab ke kaam anjaam ko pahuncha diya jaayega, aur yeh log ghaflat aur be-imaani mein hi reh jaayenge.
ayahs.40: Khud zameen ke aur tamaam zameen walon ke waaris hum hi honge aur sab log hamari hi taraf lauta kar laaye jaayenge.
ayahs.41: Is kitaab mein Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) ka qissa bayan kar, beshak woh badi sachchaai wale paighambar the.
ayahs.42: Jab ke unhon ne apne baap se kaha ke abba jaan! Aap in ki pooja paat kyun kar rahe hain jo na sunen na dekhen? Na aap ko kuchh bhi faaida pahuncha saken.
ayahs.43: Mere mehrbaan baap! Aap dekhiye mere paas woh ilm aaya hai jo aap ke paas aaya hi nahi, to aap meri hi maanen, main bilkul seedhi raah ki taraf aap ki rahbari karoonga.
ayahs.44: Mere abba jaan aap shaitan ki parastish se baaz aajaayen, shaitan to rahm-o-karam wale Allah Taala ka bada hi naafarmaan hai.
ayahs.45: Abba jaan! Mujhe khauf laga hua ke kahin aap par koi azaab-e-Ilahi na aa pade ke aap shaitan ke saathi ban jaayen.
ayahs.46: Us ne jawab diya ke aye Ibraheem! Kya tu hamare mabudon se rogardaani kar raha hai? Sun agar tu baaz na aaya to main tujhe pattharon se maar daaloonga, ja ek muddat-e-daraaz tak mujh se alag reh.
ayahs.47: Kaha achcha tum par salaam ho, main to apne parwardigar se tumhari bakhshish ki dua karta rahoonga, woh mujh par hadd darja mehrbaan hai.
ayahs.48: Main to tumhe bhi aur jin jin ko tum Allah Taala ke siwa pukaarte ho unhe bhi sab ko chhod raha hoon, sirf apne parwardigar ko pukaarta rahoonga, mujhe yaqeen hai ke main apne parwardigar se dua maang kar mahroom na rahoonga.
ayahs.49: Jab Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) in sab ko aur Allah ke siwa in ke sab mabudon ko chhod chuke to hum ne unhe Ishaaq-o-Yaqoob (alaihimas-salaam) ata farmaaye, aur donon ko nabi bana diya.
ayahs.50: Aur in sab ko hum ne apni bahut si rahmaten ata farmaayin aur hum ne in ke zikr-e-jameel ko buland darje ka kar diya.
ayahs.51: Is Quran mein Moosa (alaihis salaam) ka zikr bhi kar, jo chuna hua aur Rasool aur nabi tha.
ayahs.52: Hum ne use Toor ki daayen jaanib se nida ki aur raaz-goi karte hue use qareeb kar liya.
ayahs.53: Aur apni khaas mehrbani se is ke bhai ko nabi bana kar ata farmaaya.
ayahs.54: Is kitaab mein Ismaeel (alaihis salaam) ka waaqia bhi bayan kar, woh bada hi wade ka sachcha tha aur tha bhi Rasool aur nabi.
ayahs.55: Woh apne ghar walon ko baraabar namaz aur zakaat ka hukm deta tha, aur tha bhi apne parwardigar ki bargaah mein pasandeeda aur maqbool.
ayahs.56: Aur is kitaab mein Idrees (alaihis salaam) ka bhi zikr kar, woh bhi nek-kirdaar paighambar tha.
ayahs.57: Hum ne use buland maqaam par utha liya.
ayahs.58: Yehi woh ambiya hain jin par Allah Taala ne fazl-o-karam kiya, jo aulaad-e-Aadam mein se hain aur un logon ki nasl se hain jinhe hum ne Nooh (alaihis salaam) ke saath kashti mein chadha liya tha, aur aulaad-e-Ibraheem-o-Yaqoob se aur hamari taraf se raah-yaafta aur hamare pasandeeda logon mein se. In ke saamne jab Allah Rahman ki aayaton ki tilaawat ki jaati thi yeh sajda karte aur rote gidgidaate gir padte the.
ayahs.59: Phir in ke baad aise naa-khalaf paida hue ke unhon ne namaz zaaya kardi aur nafsaani khwahishon ke peechhe pad gaye, so un ka nuqsaan un ke aage aayega.
ayahs.60: Bajz un ke jo tauba kar len aur imaan laayen aur nek amal karen, aise log jannat mein jaayenge aur un ki zara si bhi haq-talfi na ki jaayegi.
ayahs.61: Hameshgi wali jannaton mein jin ka ghaaibaana waada Allah Rahman ne apne bandon se kiya hai, beshak is ka wada poora hone wala hi hai.
ayahs.62: Woh log wahan koi laghw baat na sunenge, sirf salaam hi salaam sunenge, un ke liye wahan subah shaam un ka rizq hoga.
ayahs.63: Yeh hai woh jannat jis ka waaris hum apne bandon mein se unhe banaate hain jo muttaqi hon.
ayahs.64: Hum baghair tere Rabb ke hukm ke utar nahi sakte, hamare aage peechhe aur in ke darmiyan ki kull cheezen usi ki milkiyat mein hain, tera parwardigar bhoolne wala nahi.
ayahs.65: Aasmanon ka, zameen ka aur jo kuchh in ke darmiyan hai sab ka Rabb wahi hai, to usi ki bandagi kar aur is ki ibaadat par jam ja. Kya tere ilm mein is ka hum-naam hum-palla koi aur bhi hai?
ayahs.66: Insan kehta hai ke jab main mar jaoonga to kya phir zinda kar ke nikaala jaoonga?
ayahs.67: Kya yeh insan itna bhi yaad nahi rakhta ke hum ne use is se pehle paida kiya, haalaanke woh kuchh bhi na tha.
ayahs.68: Tere parwardigar ki qasam! Hum unhe aur shaitanon ko jama kar ke zaroor zaroor jahannam ke ird-gird ghutnon ke bal gire hue haazir kardenge.
ayahs.69: Hum phir har har giroh se unhe alag nikaal khada karenge jo Allah Rahman se bahut akde akde phirte the.
ayahs.70: Phir hum unhe bhi khoob jaante hain jo jahannam ke daakhile ke ziyaada sazaawaar hain.
ayahs.71: Tum mein se har ek wahan zaroor waarid hone wala hai, yeh tere parwardigar ke zimme qatai, faisla-shuda amr hai.
ayahs.72: Phir hum parhezgaron ko to bacha lenge aur naafarmaanon ko usi mein ghutnon ke bal gira hua chhod denge.
ayahs.73: Jab in ke saamne hamari raushan aayaten tilaawat ki jaati hain to kaafir musalmanon se kehte hain bataao hum tum donon jamaaton mein se kis ka martaba ziyaada hai? Aur kis ki majlis shaandaar hai?
ayahs.74: Hum to in se pehle bahut si jamaaton ko ghaarat kar chuke hain jo saaz-o-saamaan aur naam-o-namood mein in se badh chadh kar thin.
ayahs.75: Keh dijiye! Jo gumraahi mein hota hai Rahman use khoob lambi mohlat deta hai, yahan tak ke woh un cheezon ko dekh len jin ka wada kiye jaate hain, yani azaab ya qayamat ko, us waqt un ko saheeh taur par maloom hojaayega ke kaun bure martabe wala aur kis ka jattha kamzor hai.
ayahs.76: Aur hidayat-yaafta logon ko Allah Taala hidayat mein badhaata hai, aur baaqi rehne wali nekiyan tere Rabb ke nazdeek sawaab ke lihaaz se aur anjaam ke lihaaz se bahut hi behtar hain.
ayahs.77: Kya tu ne use bhi dekha jis ne hamari aayaton se kufr kiya aur kaha ke mujhe to maal-o-aulaad zaroor hi di jaayegi.
ayahs.78: Kya woh ghaib par muttale hai ya Allah ka koi wada le chuka hai?
ayahs.79: Hargiz nahi, yeh jo bhi keh raha hai hum use zaroor likh lenge, aur is ke liye azaab badhaaye chale jaayenge.
ayahs.80: Yeh jin cheezon ko keh raha hai use hum is ke baad le lenge, aur yeh to bilkul akela hi hamare saamne haazir hoga.
ayahs.81: Unhon ne Allah ke siwa doosre mabood bana rakhe hain ke woh un ke liye baais-e-izzat hon.
ayahs.82: Lekin aisa hargiz hona nahi, woh to in ki pooja se munkir ho jaayenge, aur ulte in ke dushman ban jaayenge.
ayahs.83: Kya tu ne nahi dekha ke hum kaafiron ke paas shaitanon ko bhejte hain jo unhe khoob uksaate hain.
ayahs.84: To in ke baare mein jaldi na kar, hum to khud hi in ke liye muddat-shumaari kar rahe hain.
ayahs.85: Jis din hum parhezgaron ko Allah Rahman ki taraf ba-taur-e-mehmaan jama karenge.
ayahs.86: Aur gunahgaaron ko sakht pyaas ki haalat mein jahannam ki taraf haank le jaayenge.
ayahs.87: Kisi ko shafaa'at ka ikhtiyaar na hoga siwaaye un ke jinhon ne Allah Taala ki taraf se koi qaul-qaraar le liya hai.
ayahs.88: In ka qaul to yeh hai ke Allah Rahman ne bhi aulaad ikhtiyaar ki hai.
ayahs.89: Yaqeenan tum bahut buri aur bhaari cheez laaye ho.
ayahs.90: Qareeb hai ke is qaul ki wajah se aasman phat jaayen aur zameen shaq hojaaye aur pahaad reze reze ho jaayen.
ayahs.91: Ke woh Rahman ki aulaad saabit karne baithe.
ayahs.92: Shaan-e-Rahman ke laayeq nahi ke woh aulaad rakhe.
ayahs.93: Aasman-o-zameen mein jo bhi hain sab ke sab Allah ke ghulam ban kar hi aane wale hain.
ayahs.94: In sab ko us ne gher rakha hai aur sab ko poori tarah gin bhi rakha hai.
ayahs.95: Yeh saare ke saare qayamat ke din akele is ke paas haazir hone wale hain.
ayahs.96: Beshak jo imaan laaye hain aur jinhon ne shaista aamaal kiye hain un ke liye Allah Rahman mohabbat paida karega.
ayahs.97: Hum ne is Quran ko teri zabaan mein bahut hi aasan kar diya hai ke tu is ke zariye se parhezgaron ko khushkhabri de aur jhagdaalu logon ko dara de.
ayahs.98: Hum ne in se pehle bahut si jamaaten tabaah kardi hain, kya in mein se ek ki bhi aahat tu paata hai ya in ki aawaaz ki bhinak bhi tere kaan mein padti hai?
